_comment: Central source-AMI configuration. When Amazon or distro vendors change the official image name patterns, owners, or default ssh user, update this file (and commit it) — the build workflow resolves the newest matching AMI automatically at build time. No template restart needed.

amazon-linux.note: Amazon Linux 2023. When a new major Amazon Linux ships, update name_pattern (e.g. al2026-*).

debian-13.note: Debian 13 trixie (official account 136693071363). Name pattern debian-13-amd64-<date>-<rev>; root device /dev/xvda; rejects ED25519 keys (RSA injection).

fedora.note: Fedora Cloud Base release 43 (official account 125523088429). Image names are Fedora-Cloud-Base-AmazonEC2.x86_64-<release>-<build>.0; bump the release number each cycle.

rhel.note: RHEL 9 (AWS-published account 309956199498, free hourly images - no Marketplace opt-in needed).

rhel-10.note: RHEL 10 (AWS-published account 309956199498, free hourly images). Verified: rejects ED25519 keys - build passes an RSA keypair.

almalinux.note: AlmaLinux 9 (official account 679593333241). Marketplace - subscribe once (SKU 3kukoxmnoighcsbjd0u4nq9ds). Current images use ssh user ec2-user and reject ED25519 keys.

almalinux-10.note: AlmaLinux 10 (official account 679593333241), verified ec2-user + RSA-only. Marketplace - subscribe once (SKU 3kukoxmnoighcsbjd0u4nq9ds).

rocky-10.note: Rocky Linux 10 (official account 679593333241). Marketplace - subscribe once (SKU 7istt4u6drf5udz02zdppptuy). ssh_user 'rocky' assumed (verify at build - could not launch pending opt-in).

other.note: 'other' builds require an explicit AMI ID or image name passed at build time.
